summary: Make the pinned-runtime bootstrap test hermetic
description: Repair the Linux release gate exposed while shipping autonomy-01. The pinned-runtime positive fixture currently creates a lightweight tag even though bootstrap-stack.sh correctly requires annotated immutable tags; user Git configuration can mask the mismatch on macOS. Create the fixture's tag explicitly annotated without weakening production bootstrap integrity.
acceptance: The positive pinned-runtime bootstrap fixture creates an explicit annotated tag and passes with sanitized Git configuration on Linux.
The same-version wrong-commit negative test still rejects the checkout, so production exact-commit enforcement is unchanged.
